_note: House rules earned the hard way. Matched by keyword against any future shot's beat/prompt so a lesson is paid for once, ever.

lessons.lesson: a beat used to judge a CLIP must be judgeable from a single frame — describe a STATE, not a change over time. 'the crack of light widens' and 'she steps down out of the doorway' were rejected on every probe because no single frame can show a change.

identity drifts hardest when a character is SMALL in frame — wide shots came back with a smaller head and lighter orange fur and failed the identity gate. Frame characters large enough to read on-model, or build the wide as a plate and place characters via crops/inserts.

a diffusion model draws 'circus train' as a happy train rolling along. To read as trouble it must be described as STOPPED DEAD and in distress with no motion cues at all — cold, stranded, crooked on the rails, smoke pouring up.

NEVER prompt an impact or collision. Wan converts 'splinters bursting' into a continuous particle spray that reads as drilling. Render the effort, and let the bang be felt from elsewhere — dust, shudder, a widening light crack.

batch a queue BY MODEL, not by shot — all stills first, then all animations. Alternating mflux and Wan GGUF per shot pushes the box into swap and the memory gate bounces ComfyUI (~90s, six times in one hour = ~15% of wall clock).
